positions.commentary: The speaker notes that holding fast-growing companies like Amazon looks like value to him, but only in the past, not today.

thesis: This episode argues that while holding fast-growing companies like Amazon may appear to offer value, that perception is specific to the past and does not hold true in the current market environment.
